title: Renewed Mind
story:
A man followed the same routine every day.

He woke up.

Did his work.

Spent time on things that did not add value.

And went to sleep feeling tired and unfulfilled.

One day, he decided to change just one thing.

He started his day with a few quiet minutes.

He reflected.

He prayed.

He chose his thoughts carefully.

At first, the change felt small.

But day by day, his thinking began to shift.

His decisions improved.

His attitude changed.

His life slowly became more meaningful.

What changed was not his surroundings.

It was his mind.

In life, transformation does not begin outside.

It begins within.

When God renews our mind, we begin to see differently.

We choose differently.

And we start to walk in His will.
life_lesson:
Real change begins in your mind.

When God renews your thinking, your life begins to transform in every area.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Renew my mind each day.

Help me to think in ways that reflect Your truth.

Remove thoughts that do not honor You.

Guide my decisions and shape my life.

Let my transformation begin from within.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What daily habits are shaping your thinking?

Are they drawing you closer to God or away from Him?

What small change can you start today to renew your mind?
verse:
Do not conform to the pattern of this world.
But be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is.
